original_passage: Choose a shutter speed from 10 to 20 seconds and experiment with different variations to get the best result.

stored_chunk.text: NPS suggests opening the lens as wide as it allows, mentioning f/1.4 to f/3.5; beginning at ISO 400 and increasing as needed; and experimenting with exposures of 10 to 20 seconds. These are experimental starting settings in the article's tripod-based night-sky context, not guaranteed settings for every lens or a Canon EOS R1. Longer exposures can produce star trails as Earth rotates. The article does not provide an R1-specific maximum exposure time.
